subject: Post-webinar request: extend attendee trial window and compliance evidence
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Mendes <sophia@brightbridge.co>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv@brightbridge.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-webinar: trial codes for attendees and next steps

Hi Sophia and Rajiv,

Thanks again for co-hosting yesterday's 'Scaling LLM features' webinar with us — great turnout. A few attendees asked about getting a short trial so they can test Redwood against their internal prompts.

We can issue attendee trial codes scoped to 30 days with a 50k token cap by default. If you'd like us to distribute codes on your behalf we can prepare a CSV of unique codes and expiry dates.

Two asks from our side before we issue:
- Please send the attendee list (name + email) so we can stitch codes to users for analytics. A CSV is perfect.
- Because this is for a partner channel, we need a short compliance summary (SOC2 scope / any special data handling notes) for bulk issuance. A one-page PDF is fine.

If you'd prefer a longer window (45 days) due to procurement timelines on your side, loop in your procurement contact and we'll evaluate. I copied Marissa from Partnerships for approvals and Ben from Growth for budget impact.

Next steps: send the attendee CSV + compliance note and I'll route the request internally. Happy to schedule a quick 15-minute call if there are any constraints.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

Attachments: none
From: Sophia Mendes <sophia@brightbridge.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv@brightbridge.co>
Date: 2026-08-13T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-webinar: trial codes for attendees and next steps

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the quick follow-up.

Attached is the attendee list (webinar_attendee_list.csv) — about 220 unique registrants attended, ~120 stayed for the demo. Our procurement team is a bit slow this quarter; would you consider 45 days for the trial window so buyers have time to spin up PoCs? We also attached a short compliance note (compliance_summary.pdf) that outlines our expected data handling and the fact that most attendees will be evaluating on redacted transcripts.

We'd like Redwood to provision codes and drop them into an email template we send to attendees next week — can you provide a CSV with codes mapped to email addresses?

One additional ask from our side: can you include in the code terms that the trial is limited to experimental use and cannot be used for production inference? That helps our internal procurement signoff.

Thanks,
Sophia Mendes
Channel Lead, BrightBridge Labs
sophia@brightbridge.co

Attachments: webinar_attendee_list.csv (CSV, 220 rows), compliance_summary.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-webinar: trial codes for attendees and next steps — approval requested

Forwarding BrightBridge's request. Key points:
- 220 attendees; BrightBridge asks for mapped codes (we drop codes directly into their email template).
- They want 45-day windows because of procurement lag.
- Compliance summary attached — they state most evaluation will be on redacted transcripts.

Cost/ops note: 220 attendees x expected average usage ~40k tokens over window -> rough unit cost estimate = ~8M tokens total. With current hosted pricing that maps to ~ $Xk (Ben, can you confirm).

Ask: approval to issue 45-day trial codes capped at 75k tokens per account and allow Redwood to issue the CSV with per-email mappings. Also confirm we include non-production clause in the code terms. If we can't do 45 days, suggest 30 days and offer a one-time 30-day extension per user via support.

I've attached the external CSV and compliance summary.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachments: webinar_attendee_list.csv, compliance_summary.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-webinar: trial codes for attendees and next steps — approval requested

Vanessa / Ben — reviewed. Two decisions:

1) Approve issuance of mapped trial codes, delivered as a CSV with code,email,issue_date,expiry_date.
2) Approve standard 30-day trial window for attendee codes. We will not blanket-approve 45 days for partner drops due to precedent; however, we can make a case-by-case exception if procurement provides a PO or if the account meets expansion criteria.

Conditions before we issue:
- Include the non-production clause in terms and an explicit expiration timestamp on each code.
- Require the compliance_summary.pdf to be uploaded to the partner file share (linked) for audit. Please redact any sensitive PII; we should only store minimal metadata.
- Ben: please post estimated cost to BB-3491 in HubSpot and set a soft cap at 10k USD for the program. If usage exceeds that, we'll pause issuance and reassess.

Vanessa: once BrightBridge confirms they accept 30 days and ACK the non-production clause, we can schedule the code drop. Provide the final email template (so we can vet wording) and we'll generate the CSV.

Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: none
